name: portent

attributes.attribute: unsought sign that foretells an event

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: A portent is a sign that foretells an event. The entry is a cross-reference. The full account appears under OMEN and PROPHECY. A portent is an unsought gift. The flight of birds could act as a portent. It existed like an act of nature. Interpreting its meaning was a skill of the druids. The barguest led all the dogs of the dead, and it was a portent of death. A figure could also be a portent of doom, warning of misfortune to come.

okr.objective: Present the portent as a cross-reference to omen and prophecy.
key_results: Cross-references portent to OMEN and PROPHECY
Contrasts the portent as an unsought gift with prophecy as a courted ritual
